# Text & Code Summarization

Generates concise summaries of text documents or source code files.

## Usage
- Produces abstractive or extractive summaries based on input length
- Supports summarization of documents, articles, and code files
- Configurable summary length (short, medium, detailed)
- Preserves key facts, arguments, and logic flow in output
